<h2 id="One-Month-on-NammaMetro"><strong>One Month on NammaMetro</strong></h2><p>Remember that NammaMetro fails to report ridership numbers on some days, so the monthly ridership totals calculated from the data is going to be only an approximate. However, we can still identify trends and patterns by analysing data movement on a granular level.</p>
<p>Here are the official monthly ridership stats as reported by BMRCL:</p>
